benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Accidental air cover worth ₹1 crore, Credit liability cover worth ₹9 lakh.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact at 1800-266-9777 or schedule a call. You can also send a missed call to +91-9980970424 or email buyonline@hdfclife.in.

benefitRows.name: Swiggy
benefitRows.description: Swiggy One and MMT Black Gold membership
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary Swiggy One and MMT Black Gold membership when you spend ₹1 lakh or more within 90 days of card issuance.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 7.5% savings at participating restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC Regalia Gold credit card to unlock the offer.
